title: Itz Create
description: The official Modpack for the Itz Create Minecraft server! - Moved from curseforge
body:
![Season 6](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dd395513420699c68e08fb9636fce8a8ce3d21cb.png)

Itz Create is a Create and exploration focused modpack for Minecraft 1.21.1 put together by Dadude_Gaming for his modded server. (Invite only)

Modpack for Create, addons and structures. Intended to be used with the Modrinth app neoforge loader.

This season we are using many exciting mods such as Advanced Netherite, CERBON's Better Beacons, a ton of Create factory (6.0) addons and the new Create: Enchantment Industry (2.0)!

Mentionable returning mods: SecurityCraft, Create, Create: Mobile Packages.

**We have also added Chunky to pre generate the world to help redice the server lag when travelling.**

I will also be making some small addons that will be added in future updates to add missing features.

The main focus of this modpack is building Create factories and hanging out with friends. It is to also explore and spark your creativity!

Please respect indevidual mod licenses.
